thread:
elaine: Quick sync: I opened a focused migration quickstart to cover v1->v2 essentials (PR 4980). We need: updated SDK snippets, a short embed-dim note, and an alias fallback example. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4980

sam: I can take SDK snippets. Found a TS sample still using old param names and models. Will update to responses.create and new model ids.

lina: Heads-up on embeddings: rwd-embed -> rwd-embed-v2 moves from 1536 to 2048 dims. Add a tiny conversion note and a snippet showing how to pad/trim vectors. Also link to the embed-dim migration doc.

matt: Working on the code block. Proposed TS example:
```ts
const resp = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'rwd/text-embedding-1',
  input: 'hello redwood'
})
// resp.output[0].embedding -> Float32Array(2048)
```

noah: From support: please include an alias-fallback JSON example for teams that want old routing behavior plus a recommended rollout plan (canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%). Also add a note: Dedicated customers have higher sustained rate-limits but lower burst capacity.

docs-bot: linkcheck: broken -> https://old-links.redwood.ai/sdk/v1/snippets should redirect to /sdk/migration.

sam: I'll add the redirect, update snippets, and add a short changelog blurb in the same PR.

deploy-bot: CI triggered for PR 4980 (lint, linkcheck, snippet smoke-tests).

matt: Lint note: JSON examples must use double quotes. I'll reformat the alias JSON accordingly.

elaine: Owner = @sam. Please get changes in by EOD so I can merge if CI is green. Post any blockers here. Thanks! :raised_hands:
